description: This file contains the implementation of the MenuActiveTrail class in Drupal, responsible for managing the active menu trail based on current route and path, utilizing caching and route matching.

classes.name: MenuActiveTrail
classes.description: Default implementation of the active menu trail service, managing active trail IDs and links based on route and path.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MenuActiveTrail object with dependencies like menu link manager, route match, cache, lock, and optional path matcher.

methods.name: getCid
methods.description: Generates a cache ID based on current route name and parameters.

methods.name: resolveCacheMiss
methods.description: Handles cache misses by computing active trail IDs and setting cache tags.

methods.name: getActiveTrailIds
methods.description: Retrieves active trail IDs for a given menu, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: doGetActiveTrailIds
methods.description: Computes the active trail IDs based on the active link and its parent IDs.

methods.name: getActiveLink
methods.description: Finds the active menu link based on current route and path, considering front page and route-specific links.
